title: Dewooɓe Fotooɓe
intro: Annabaajo teddinaaɗo ina yaha hakkunde yimɓe, ina nodda ɓe feewde e goonga. Heewɓe njirloyii e tiiɗnaare, kono fedde tokosere dewondirnde jaabtii noddaango ngoo, fodanii koye mum en e ɓerɗe mum en fof. Ɓe jarribaama e sikke, ɓe cuusi ɗaɓɓude nguura asamaan. Dewal maɓɓe ngal ustataako, wonti jannde nde alaa ɗo haaɗi e iimanaagal. Hol ɓe ngonnoo?
clues: Min ngonnoo ko fedde tokosere ummiinde ngam wallitde njillu diine e nder yonta keefeere yaajnde.
Annabi tedduɗo ari, noddi en nde ndarotoɗen e laawol Alla.
Nde annabi naamndii hol wonɓe wallitooɓe Diine, min njaabii min mbeltiima.
En cuusii ɗaɓɓude juulde kaawis jippiinde e asamaan ngam semmbinde ɓerɗe men.
Annabi men siftinii en yoo en teddin Alla so tawii ko en gooŋɗinɓe goonga, kono tan ɗaɓɓaande men leslesre ndee teddinaama.
Minen ko min cirkel ndernderiwal dewondirngal fodoore gooŋɗinal ngal aldaa e paltoor e bannge Isa, ɓiy Maryam.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Yamireede yo resndu gelooɗi debbo kaawis
Dogde e nder ngaska ngam daɗde e tooñanngeeji

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: En ngonti gooŋɗinɓe tiiɗɓe e jaaltaaɓe
Min halkaama e jukkungo iwngo dow
En ɗaaniima e nder ngaska fotde teemedde duuɓi
Min kaɗaama naatde e leydi ceniindi
outcome.answer: En ngonti gooŋɗinɓe tiiɗɓe e jaaltaaɓe

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
